turns.text: Hi Divya, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Mobile annual plan is set to end on 1 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, okay, that makes sense. Yes, English is fine, I'm honestly just happy to get a reminder about this since I completely forgot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, glad I could remind you! So, what made you cancel the AutoPay earlier?

turns.speaker: persona

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries at all, that happens often when cards get reissued. Since you'd like to continue, there's actually a loyalty gesture for you: 5% off if you reactivate before 1 August. Would you give it another shot?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, okay, that sounds perfect. Yes, I'll give it another shot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great! Just open the JioHotstar app and go to the subscription section. The 5% discount is already applied there, so you can reactivate easily. Shall I wait while you do it, or is there anything else you'd like to know?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I'm doing that now. When is the next billing date for the plan after I reactivate?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Once you reactivate today, your next billing date will be 1 August 2027. Did the discount show up correctly in the app?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Okay, I've checked, and yes, the 5% discount is applied. The next billing date will be 1 August 2027.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great to hear! So, your plan is all set to renew with the discount. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: That's all for now. I'm good.
